_doc: Copy to ggest.json next to data.sqlite (or point GGEST_CONFIG at it), adapt, then run: uv run ggest build-views. Keys you leave out keep their defaults (bi/config.default.json). Lists replace the default list.
_excluded_series_prefixes: invoice series that are not trading revenue (e.g. sale of a company vehicle)
_service_items: service_item_codes: always count these items as services (no cost); product_item_codes: never reclassify these (e.g. a bundle of equipment + labour with a real cost). Keywords: service_description_like (see config.default.json)
_series_groups: invoice series with a business meaning; other series fall in default_series_group
_expense_rules: first matching rule wins; codes = creditor codes (outros credores); name_like / text_like = SQL LIKE on creditor name / document text (lower case); all=true: code AND text must match
_regions: where customers are (view customer_regions): first rule whose 4-digit postcode range matches; customers without a postcode: first rule whose address words match (SQL LIKE on ' lower-case address ')
_areas: finer areas, in priority order: postcode range, then address words, then postal_names (locality name in gGest's codpostal table); otherwise the codpostal locality itself
